definition: China's preferred term for LLMs. Literally 'big model'. Used for both open and closed models.
example: 百度发布了新的大模型。

definition: AI systems that interact with the physical world through a robotic body. The dominant framing for China's humanoid robot sector.
example: 具身智能是当前投资热点。

definition: Shorthand for GPU/chip-based processing capacity. 算力战 = 'compute war' (US-China chip competition).
example: 中国正在大力投资算力基础设施。

definition: Biped robots designed to resemble and operate like humans. Key physical AI segment in China.
example: 宇树科技生产人形机器人。

definition: Hangzhou-based AI lab backed by High-Flyer Quant (幻方量化). Known for cost-efficient frontier models.
example: 深度求索发布了新版大模型。

definition: Quantitative hedge fund and backer of DeepSeek. Founded by Liang Wenfeng (梁文锋).
example: 幻方量化是深度求索的母公司。

definition: Leading Chinese humanoid robot company. Private. Known for Go1, H1, G1 robot lines.
example: 宇树科技正在进行D轮融资。

definition: HKEX-listed (9880) humanoid robot company. Walker S1 deployed in automotive factories.
example: 优必选在港交所上市。

definition: Huawei's domestic AI chip series (Ascend 910B, 910C). Primary domestic alternative to NVIDIA.
example: 华为昇腾是英伟达的国内替代方案。

definition: The dominant GPU manufacturer. Critical to AI training. Subject of US export controls to China.
example: 英伟达的H100芯片受到出口限制。

definition: World's largest power grid operator (88% of China's territory). In 2026, committed 6.8B yuan to procure ~8,500 AI-powered robots across 26 regions — the largest single govt AI robot procurement in Chinese history.
example: 国家电网采购了大量人工智能机器人。

en: SAFE — State Admin. of Foreign Exchange

definition: Robots designed for domestic tasks: cooking, cleaning, laundry. GigaAI SeeLight S1 is the first Chinese household humanoid targeting this category.
example: GigaAI发布了家政机器人时光S1。

definition: US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) restrictions on semiconductor exports to China. Progressively banned A100, H100, H800, H200, and Blackwell chips.
example: 出口管制导致英伟达退出中国市场。

definition: Monthly survey index published by NBS (~last day of month). Above 50 = expansion; below 50 = contraction. Key leading indicator for Chinese manufacturing and services activity.
example: NBS公布5月采购经理人指数为52.2，显示制造业扩张。

definition: Huawei's chip design architecture unveiled at IEEE ISCAS Shanghai (May 25, 2026). Built on the Tau Scaling Law (τ缩放定律) which reframes chip design around reducing signal propagation latency rather than shrinking transistors. First implementation on Kirin smartphones (late 2026), Ascend AI chips by 2030. Target: 1.4nm-equivalent transistor density by 2031 without advanced lithography.
example: 华为发布逻辑折叠架构，昇腾芯片将于2030年采用。

definition: The policy and market trend of replacing foreign-made components (especially semiconductors, AI chips, HBM memory) with Chinese domestic alternatives. A core theme of China's tech self-reliance strategy. DeepSeek's Engram paper (May 2026) represents a software-side approach to reducing HBM dependence, complementing hardware-side efforts by Huawei Ascend and CXMT.
example: 国产替代是中国科技自立战略的核心主题。

definition: National initiative (2022) routing data center construction from China's energy-constrained east to the renewable-rich west. Builds 8 national compute hubs. NDRC target: lift data center utilization from 20–30% to 60% by end-2026.
example: 东数西算战略将推动宁夏等西部地区数据中心建设。

definition: People's Bank of China. China's central bank. Sets interest rates, manages RRR, FX reserves.
example: Key for rate/RRR cut calls. Signals matter for China fixed income + equity positioning.

definition: % of deposits banks must hold in reserve. PBOC cuts RRR to inject liquidity. Often abbreviated 准备金率.
example: Primary monetary easing lever. Watch for 25-50bps cuts as growth slows.

definition: China's chief administrative authority. Equivalent to Cabinet. Chaired by the Premier.
example: Issues major fiscal and economic policy directives.

definition: China's official statistics agency. Releases GDP, CPI, PMI, and other macro data.
example: Primary source for official macro numbers. Data credibility sometimes debated.

definition: Govt program: exchange old goods (EVs, appliances, electronics) for discounts on new. Key stimulus tool.
example: Major driver of consumer durables demand in 2025-26 cycle. Expanded to AI hardware.

definition: The real estate sector. A dominant factor in China's macro story since Evergrande crisis (2021).
example: Persistent drag on GDP. Key downside risk for China equity / credit exposure.

definition: Short for 国家补贴. Government subsidy, often for consumer goods or industrial sectors.
example: Watch 国补 programs as leading indicators of policy-driven demand cycles.

definition: One of China's largest financial conglomerates: insurance, banking, fintech. HKEX: 2318.
example: Major institutional user of AI/ML in risk and customer service.

definition: One of China's largest joint-stock commercial banks. Known for retail banking quality. HKEX: 3968.
example: Bellwether for China consumer credit quality and fintech adoption.

definition: Interest rate. 贷款利率 (lending rate), 存款利率 (deposit rate), LPR (Loan Prime Rate) are key terms.
example: LPR cuts are key monetary easing signals. Watch monthly PBOC announcements.

definition: CSRC approval allowing a firm to underwrite, broker, or advise in China's onshore capital markets. Wholly foreign-owned firms need a separate application from JVs. Citi received one in May 2026.
example: 花旗集团终于拿到了证券牌照。

definition: 100% foreign equity in a subsidiary — no required local JV partner. Available to foreign securities/AM firms in China since 2020 policy liberalization.
example: 花旗在华设立全资控股证券子公司。

definition: Major US bank. Received CSRC approval for a wholly owned China securities firm in May 2026, timed to the Trump-Xi Beijing summit after a 4-year wait. One of 7 foreign banks with this designation.
example: 花旗集团获批在华设立独资证券公司。

definition: Rate at which banks lend to each other overnight. PBOC Q1 2026 report formally elevated this as the primary liquidity management anchor — first time made explicit — signalling shift from broad RRR/rate cuts to precision tools.
example: 人民银行将隔夜利率作为新的流动性管理锚。

definition: PBOC's toolkit for managing money supply, interest rates, and credit. Current stance (Dec 2025 CEWC): 'moderately loose' (适度宽松). Q1 2026 report signals shift toward structural tools over broad-based RRR/rate cuts.
example: 央行的货币政策保持适度宽松。

definition: Cross-border trade in digital goods, services, and data — including e-commerce, digital platforms, AI services, and electronic certification. China used its APEC 2026 presidency to advance a regional digital trade framework at the Suzhou ministerial (May 22-23, 2026), with an AI trade ministerial planned in Chengdu in July 2026.
example: China's APEC presidency creates agenda-setting power to embed Chinese digital standards (data flows, AI governance, e-commerce certification) into Asia-Pacific frameworks ahead of a US counter-position. Watch Chengdu ministerial July 2026.

definition: Founded DeepSeek from his quant fund. Key architect of China's cost-efficient AI strategy.
significance: Founded DeepSeek from his quant fund. Key architect of China's cost-efficient AI strategy.

definition: Pioneer of Chinese internet search. Pivoting Baidu to AI/autonomous driving via ERNIE Bot.
significance: Pioneer of Chinese internet search. Pivoting Baidu to AI/autonomous driving via ERNIE Bot.

definition: Founder of Huawei. Central figure in China's push for semiconductor self-sufficiency.
significance: Founder of Huawei. Central figure in China's push for semiconductor self-sufficiency.

definition: Built China's dominant food delivery/local services platform. Pivoting to AI-powered logistics.
significance: Built China's dominant food delivery/local services platform. Pivoting to AI-powered logistics.

definition: Founder of TikTok/Douyin parent. ByteDance is a major LLM and AI infrastructure investor.

significance: China's Premier. Chairs State Council. Key economic policy executor under Xi Jinping.

Beijing-based AI startup behind the GLM series of large language models. Backed by Alibaba and Tencent. One of China's leading foundation model providers.
Shanghai-listed AI chip company (STAR Market: 688256). Produces MLU series AI accelerators. One of China's earliest dedicated AI chip firms.
AI systems or interfaces designed to mimic human emotional responses, personality, or appearance. Subject to China's algorithm regulation framework.
China's primary internet and AI regulator. Oversees algorithm registration, content moderation, and data governance rules.
China's mandatory registration system for recommendation and generative AI algorithms, administered by the CAC. Requires disclosure of training data, usage scenarios, and safety measures.
Regulatory principle in China's AI governance framework requiring AI systems to be technically controllable and socially trustworthy. A key criterion in the CAC's AI safety assessment guidelines.
Independent Chinese financial media group publishing Caixin Global (English) and Caixin Weekly. Produces the widely-cited Caixin China PMI series.
Chinese government bonds with maturities of 30-50 years issued for strategic investment in infrastructure, technology, and domestic consumption. Key fiscal stimulus tool since 2024.
AI model component that recognizes and responds to human emotional states. Increasingly integrated into humanoid robot control systems for natural human-robot interaction.
In robotics, the number of independent axes of motion a robot joint or end-effector can move along. Higher DOF enables more dexterous manipulation. Measured per joint and in aggregate.
Time-of-use electricity pricing scheme that charges higher rates during peak demand periods and lower rates during off-peak hours. Affects AI data center operating economics in China.

In Hong Kong IPOs, an anchor investor who commits to buying a fixed allocation at the IPO price and is locked up for 6 months. Prominent cornerstone commitments signal institutional confidence and improve deal pricing.
First sale of a company's shares to the public on a stock exchange. In context: Chinese AI and robotics companies increasingly listing on Hong Kong's HKEX.

In robotics AI, a curated repository of learned manipulation skills that a robot can retrieve and compose for new tasks, rather than relearning from scratch. Core concept in Nvidia's ASPIRE framework.

Chinese policy framework designating commercial use of airspace below 1,000m — drone logistics, agricultural UAVs, eVTOL air taxis, surveying — as a priority growth sector. Market projected to exceed ¥2 trillion by 2030.

CAAC-issued certification required for civil aircraft (including drones and eVTOLs) to legally operate in Chinese airspace. Mandatory for all medium and large civil drones under the July 1, 2026 revised Civil Aviation Law.

Shenzhen-based world leader in consumer and commercial drones. Products: Phantom, Mavic, Agras, Matrice series. On US Entity List since 2020. Now subject to CAAC mandatory airworthiness certification regime (July 2026).

Guangzhou-based eVTOL manufacturer listed on NASDAQ (EH). EH216-S received China's first civil aircraft type certificate from CAAC in 2023. Positioned in the low-altitude economy as an early-mover with regulatory clearance.

Retaliatory policy tools authorized under Decree 837 (Art. 23-25) against jurisdictions that restrict Chinese investors. Signals China's intent to match Western investment screening with reciprocal measures.
Making AI human-like in personality or emotional behavior; the trigger concept for China's Interim Measures on AI anthropomorphized interaction services (effective July 15, 2026).
Mandatory usage-limit and dependence-detection systems; required for AI companion services under the July 15, 2026 rules, extending a framework first used for minors in gaming.
User over-attachment to AI companions; services must detect and intervene against it in real time under the anthropomorphized-AI Interim Measures.
Semiconductor memory (DRAM/NAND). CXMT (长鑫存储), China's only mass DRAM producer, priced the largest A-share semiconductor IPO ever on July 15, 2026.
IPO option letting underwriters sell extra shares to meet demand; CXMT's greenshoe lifts its raise from ¥57.9B to ¥66.6B.

en: Total retail sales of consumer goods
definition: China's headline monthly consumption indicator from the NBS; rose 1.0% YoY in June 2026, with autos down 16.1%.
The Communist Party's top decision-making meetings; the April and July sessions set economic policy direction. The late-July 2026 meeting is the venue for a response to the Q2 GDP miss.
Rack-scale AI computing unit aggregating thousands of accelerators over high-bandwidth interconnect; Huawei's Atlas 950 SuperPoD (8,192 Ascend NPUs) debuted publicly at WAIC 2026.

zh: 世界人工智能合作组织
definition: Proposed China-led international AI governance body headquartered in Shanghai, elevated by Xi Jinping's first WAIC keynote on July 17, 2026.
Attention mechanism whose cost grows linearly with sequence length; Moonshot's Kimi-Linear hybrid claims ~75% KV-cache reduction, enabling practical 1M-token context.
Official policy phrase for stabilizing the property market — the benchmark against which monthly 70-city home price data is read.
Existing-home market; June 2026 second-hand prices fell 0.32% m/m — the worst in four months — even as new-home declines eased.
Architecture coordinating many AI sub-agents in parallel on one task; Kimi K3 claims support for up to 300 concurrent sub-agents.

Smartphone whose on-device AI operates apps on the user's behalf rather than only answering questions; StepFun's STEPX Neo and ZTE Nubia's rival device both claimed the 'world-first' title at WAIC 2026.
Operating system; StepFun's Step AOS reworks the OS around agents — replacing the file+app paradigm with intent+task orchestration.

Consumer robot category centered on the individual (companionship, learning, creation) rather than industrial or household task work; category Swancor Qiyuan is trying to define with the Q1 and Quester1.

Multi-morphology robot that switches forms on one chassis — e.g. Quester1 (wheeled-bipedal ↔ quadruped), Unitree's GD01 manned mecha, LimX TRON 2 — a differentiated Chinese design path vs single-form Western humanoids.
Honorific for a museum's or exhibition's centerpiece artifact; WAIC awards the label to standout exhibits — StepFun's STEPX Neo received it in 2026.

Going public by acquiring control of an already-listed shell company instead of a conventional IPO; AgiBot-affiliated vehicles' takeover of Swancor Advanced Materials (688585) is the robotics cycle's highest-profile example.
Officialese for additional stimulus measures beyond those already announced; the phrase to watch in the late-July 2026 Politburo readout after the sub-target Q2.
